cohort: 1773 women who conceived ≤6 months following a missed abortion
finding: There was no significant difference in the rate of preterm birth or other adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes between women who conceived ≤6 months after D&C and those who conceived after non-medical or spontaneous miscarriage.
mod_finding: This study found no difference in the rate of preterm birth between women who conceived ≤6 months after D&C and those who had non-medical or spontaneous miscarriages.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was examined but no difference was found between groups.
